body:
Native Linux check through the maintained Windows launcher, proven by Sol-03d4 on 2026-11-03 (Fable2 request2231). Run from your own named root. Exact successful PowerShell command for this lane:
node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- C:/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command 'wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "cd /mnt/c/github/Personal/TermAl/.tmp/wt-remove-turn-gating-12327 && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/mnt/c/github/Personal/TermAl/.tmp/linux-wsl-target-12327 cargo check --bin termal"; exit $LASTEXITCODE'
For the test configuration replace the inner command with cargo check --bin termal --tests. Substitute your own source-root path and distinct repository-local .tmp/linux-wsl-target-SESSION target; do not share another lane's build lock. Ubuntu already has cargo at /home/greg/.cargo/bin and gcc; no installation/global change. Windows git supplies identity: WSL git cannot read the C:/ pointer in a Windows linked worktree.
Why the wrapper: direct launcher wsl.exe -d ... fails127 before Cargo because the Windows owner quotes every option, which WSL treats as a command: /bin/bash -d command not found. Exact quoted-option .NET probe reproduced it. Bare pwsh.exe is absent from the launcher PATH (UNRUN); the absolute existing Windows PowerShell path above works and exit LASTEXITCODE preserves native Cargo status. No output filtering pipeline required.
Proven production PASS: test-3d51611c-867d-4262-99f5-41652dc1fa7c END01:32:40.310Z, clean commit0c383ae852bc939e834ce4b3aa75d9648b92e9a0, before/after f89ac76e8212f230bc07087f2fee4069770d2957f8a808f202d4a1257d083f51. Same wrapper previously reached real Unix E0282 on ca3 (f8091dcf); explicit Result<Output> fixed that compile defect. Compile checks are evidence, not recognized Test records.
